desc: Derive and verify the closed-form pair-distance sums: rowsum(m) = Σ_{r1<r2} (r2−r1) = m(m²−1)/6, similarly colsum(n); verified against the 2×2 and 1×4 examples analytically.
Implement factorial/inverse-factorial precomputation up to N = m*n (≤1e5) mod 1e9+7 for computing C(mn−2, k−2).
Implement the main formula: ans = (rowsum(m)·n² + colsum(n)·m²) % MOD · C(mn−2, k−2) % MOD, handling the /6 via modular inverse of 6.
Handle edge cases: m=1 or n=1 (one of rowsum/colsum is 0), k=2 (C(mn−2,0)=1), k=mn (C(mn−2, mn−2)=1), mn=2 boundary.
Validate against both provided examples (expect 8 and 20) and a brute-force enumerator for random small cases (m,n ≤ 4).
Write final solution in the required `class Solution: def distanceSum(...)` format with code enclosed in delimiters.
